title: calycera crassifolia var. spinuligera
intro: Calycera crassifolia var. spinuligera, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the Calyceraceae family, is a species of Calycera. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Latin America, due to its various health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Calycera crassifolia var. spinuligera include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
